name: Mimi Pearlbaton
source:
A member of [url=/c52315]Anastasia[/url] Camp, and the older triplet sister of both Hetaro and Tivey. She is one of the three vice captains of the mercenary group Fang of Iron. Mimi has a bright and optimistic personality with straightforward intentions. Unlike her brothers, she talks in third person. She typically acts like a child, often causing problems for her brothers. She considers the other members of the Fang of Iron to be family and loves them, referring to Ricardo as their father, who also took the triplets in after they were abandoned by their parents.

[From [url=https://rezero.fandom.com/wiki/Mimi_Pearlbaton]Re:Zero Wiki[/url]]
